note: Themes listed in order of what needs your attention today. Where a theme sits on the curve decides IF buying is even allowed; a review session decides WHAT and WHEN. Aug 28 read is a Curve Analysis scan - provisional until the next Board ratifies.

themes.name: Agentic AI
themes.stage: recovery under way at the app layer; the J-curve is at the model layer
themes.action: The despair phase passed in July-August: ServiceNow +30% and Salesforce +43% off their lows on multiple resets, Palantir back to $186. Every accessible name is now above its solved level. The real curve is at the model layer - Anthropic ~$65B run-rate (7x this year), OpenAI ~$40B - and it comes public this fall. Rules: buy only at the set prices below, and read the Anthropic S-1 the week it lands.

themes.name: AI infra & memory

Re-look levels are re-solved off that print. A price alert here means come review the name - it never means buy.

themes.name: AI-enabled healthcare
themes.stage: proof arriving, mostly priced in private markets
themes.action: The winners are private and expensive: Abridge (~$100M+ ARR, $5.3B) and OpenEvidence (~$100M ARR, $12B) at 50-120x revenue. The one scaled public pure play, Tempus, just posted its first profit - then ran 60% in a month on a device clearance, not on new numbers. Its growth is slowing as an acquisition laps. Watch the level; read Q3 in November.

themes.name: Robotics / physical AI
themes.stage: hype peaked (Unitree IPO); proof still missing
themes.action: The first public humanoid mark arrived Aug 19: Unitree opened near 250x sales and gave back a third in three days - on a leader whose growth is slowing and whose profit is falling. Tesla's robot has $0 outside revenue; Waymo's rides went flat last quarter. The real robot cash flows are surgery (Intuitive) and warehouses (Symbotic), and both are priced. We buy nothing until a proof event lands; then we pay that day's price if the math works.
